_meta.about: Career paths: the jobs O*NET lists as related to each of the app's jobs, and each job's O*NET Job Zone. Links and zones are in the lazy chunks next to this file; only src/utils/careerPaths.ts reads them. Pay and AI Exposure are not stored here.
_meta.label: Similar jobs you could move to (O*NET, by similar skills and work)
_meta.notMeaning: Not where people actually moved: O*NET relates jobs by similar tasks, knowledge and titles, not by real moves.
